rules-content.title: Allowed on the air?

cases.situation: A club net discussing the club's emergency plan.
cases.why: Emergency planning is fine; business planning isn't.

cases.situation: A member selling equipment from their shop on the net.
Broadcasting a public weather bulletin for everyone listening.
cases.why: Amateurs may never broadcast to the general public.

cases.situation: Sending data with an encoding you published openly online.
cases.why: It's not secret: it's in the public domain.

rules-content.success: No business, no broadcasting, nothing secret.
